package.name: yahboomcar_sim
package.description: A simulated Yahboom microROS car that stands in for the FIRMWARE, not for the stack. It publishes exactly what the board publishes and subscribes to exactly what the board subscribes to, so bringup, the safety governor, SLAM, Nav2 and RViz all run against it completely unmodified. Faithful to the board's awkward properties too, including the absence of a command watchdog.
